notes.title: New menus with plane stats and changes to ambient sounds
notes.notes:
We have updated the menus to include plane stats and a representation of the rotating aircraft. It is now also easier to hop into your friends Hansa W.29 as a gunner.

We are adding more and more ambient sounds and effects. In this latest version we have added a spatial gliding noise to airframe and changed the ambient effect in clouds and fog.

Various bug fixes and niceties include changes to player hands when acting as the gunner.

notes.title: New multiplayer code for engines / buoyancy changes
notes.notes:
New multiplayer code for engines
buoyancy improvements adding more friction to landing

notes.title: Scenery changes
notes.notes: Turned down the volume of the ambient sounds by the house

notes.title: Map update for seaplane
notes.notes: We wanted to land the seaplane anywhere, you can.

notes.title: Life quality fixes and a new major release with new solo mode
notes.notes:
You can now play Fokker vs Sopwith in solo.
Changes to networking needed for upcoming new a/c variations.

notes.title: Bomb fix and water changes
notes.notes:
In rare circumstances, the bomb could damage the launching plane and not in a fun way!

Added a wake to the boat.

notes.title: Bomb release without controllers
notes.notes:
We have had requests to allow the bomb to be released without the VR controllers. This is useful if you prefer to fly traditional stick with VR controls.

Look down and right to hold the bomb. Release with trigger.

notes.title: Fixed camera on non-VR version
notes.notes:
Patch to fix the camera on the non-VR version.

The game can run both in VR and non-VR. Go to settings and toggle VR.

notes.title: Camera patch
notes.notes: This fixes issues with the underwater effect not being present after a team swap

notes.title: More bomb changes
notes.notes: Throwing bombs is tricky. We have allowed bombs to glance off your own fuselage to make throwing easy. Be warned, these do detonate on your own a/c.

notes.title: Fixed changes to rudder pedals on Sopwith
notes.notes: Small bug fix - there for only 10 mins

notes.title: Full XR control (yoke and others) - currently alpha version (see comments)
notes.notes:
Following our recent change to support HOTAS - we are looking at fully supporting VR controllers.
This version lets you use VR to control: throttle, yoke, machine guns and view directions 

We are midst updating the animations to work with this version but ignoring the hand positions - you can now fly around using VR.
